name: Mill St. Plaza
summary: Mill St. Plaza is a fully-leased 66,281-square-foot strip center in Worcester, Massachusetts, serving the local urban population with a strong tenant mix. The property's prime location and complete occupancy demonstrate its success in this established market.

description: Mill St. Plaza is a well-established 66,281-square-foot strip center strategically located at 50 Mill Street in Worcester, Massachusetts, the second largest city in the Commonwealth. This fully-leased property serves the local urban population with a strong tenant roster that has proven its appeal in this established market. The center benefits from its prime Worcester location, drawing from a substantial trade area population of nearly 390,000 residents within a 10-mile radius. Mill St. Plaza's success is evidenced by its full occupancy status, with interested retailers joining a waitlist for future availability. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, the property exemplifies quality neighborhood retail serving the everyday needs of Worcester's diverse community.
